Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000401": As of 2025-05-20, the Atlas team owns the indexer, having taken it over from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000345": The indexer's OpenSearch 2.11 pin lifts when the full reindex completes.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11)
- memory_id "1000341": As of 2025-04-22, the indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11)
- memory_id "1000154": The search indexer relies on the catalog service for product documents, so if the catalog service is down, the search indexer is down.  (about: indexer, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000421": The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000329" [decision]: Decision on 2025-04-17: the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000417": INC-2025-011 affected the ledger service on 2025-05-24.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000611" [decision]: As of 2025-09-02, clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: feature-flags, clients)
- memory_id "1000331": In the catalog service, joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000228": On 2025-02-21, the Boreal team noticed the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000424" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000167": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004, broker)
- memory_id "1000163": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000172" [decision]: After INC-2025-004, the notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000575": The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000708" [decision]: As of 2025-09-30, the billing API will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.  (about: billing API, feature-flags, new invoice flow)
- memory_id "1000578" [decision]: After INC-2025-017, certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000690": The nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs, which prompted the reporting service to switch from the ledger service to the bus.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000571": INC-2025-017 affected the auth gateway, which rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000220" [decision]: As of 2025-02-21, the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
Existing entity names: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer, OpenSearch 2.11, catalog service, ledger service, INC-2025-011, feature-flags, clients, product catalog, Boreal team, notifier, INC-2025-004, broker, auth gateway, INC-2025-017, billing API, new invoice flow, the bus, reporting service
